Privacy & Data Handling

Current Data Model

DealyVIP operates strictly as an informational and coordination layer. We do not maintain a complex backend database of user profiles.

  • We do not implement user accounts or client portals.
  • We do not process or store payment information on this domain.
  • We do not store your communication in an automated CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system.

Communication Privacy

If you contact us via direct email or external messaging platforms (such as WhatsApp), your data is handled according to standard email and communication protocols.

  • No Automatic Analytics Processing: We do not algorithmically process your messages for marketing.
  • Security Limitations: Standard email and third-party messaging apps are not secure channels for sensitive financial data. Do not send unredacted bank passwords, personal identity documents, or secure commercial secrets during initial contact.

Analytics and Cookies

This website is built statically. We aim for a zero-JS default where possible and do not aggressively track users across the web.

Effective Date: May 2024. This policy reflects actual technical implementation, not boilerplate legal padding.
